problem_statement: Users block purchases out of fear that delivery will be late or returns will be difficult/rejected.
Users face friction when items or specific sizes are out of stock, with no visibility on restocks.
Users abandon purchases due to lack of trust in the platform, third-party seller, or unfamiliar brand.
Users hesitate because they cannot trust the product reviews or are uncertain about the actual quality.
Users delay buying because they are uncertain if the current price represents good value or if it will drop soon.
Users frequently postpone purchases because they lack confidence in whether the item will fit them or which size to choose.
Users are overwhelmed by choices and struggle to compare shortlisted items to make a final decision.
Users delay purchases to seek opinions and validation from friends, family, or social media.
Users hesitate because they don't know how to style the item or if it's appropriate for their specific occasion.
